tex_content.html:
The presurgery manifold is obtained from the postsurgery manifold by finitely many applications of:

  • replacing two connected components by their connected sum;

  • taking connected sum with $S^1\times S^2$ or $\R P^3$;

  • adjoining $S^1\times S^2$ or an isometric quotient of round $S^3$.

Remark
[structural remark on Ricci flow with surgery]
